proposition: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I answers the accusations made by Ibn Turka's enemies in Yazd at Shāhrukh's court in Herat, and was completed in Herat on 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426 (also the date of its Majlis 10196 copy, in the chronological first half).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, in Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I
mediation.note: his account of his accusers' motives; MK: apologies produced under great duress
